title: Open payer offers filter
spec: Add src/payee/open-offers.ts: openPayerOffers(frames, nowMs, opts): DecodedFrame[] where DecodedFrame = { seq, ts, frame, verified }. Keep offers that are verified, type offer, role payer, lock hash, not from opts.selfDid, not expired (expiresMs > nowMs), share a rail with opts.rails (default ["paper"]), pass tclk validateDeadlines(offer, nowMs, opts.minClaimMs ?? 5 min, opts.minGapMs ?? 60 s), are not in opts.lockedOffers, and have no accept from a DID outside opts.ignoreAccepts unless opts.allowAccepted(offer.from) is true.
done: The public frames fixture yields exactly the expected offer ids for each option combination.
